results.title: An End-to-End Data and Machine Learning Pipeline for ...
results.content: The proposed framework introduces multiple gated checkpoints with clear criteria (e.g., data quality metrics, model performance thresholds, validation acceptance by domain experts) that must be met to proceed forward, which increases process automation opportunities while also making the workflow logic explicit and auditable. The framework provides phase-specific guidance from overall forecasting target and horizon requirements to detailed data quality metrics, feature generation criteria, and model performance benchmarks. Compliance officers and QA professionals ensure regulatory adherence throughout the pipeline, establishing compliance frameworks in Phase 0, providing oversight for data processing and model development activities in Phases 1–4, and validating that automated systems maintain governance and traceability standards in Phase 6. Phase deliverables comprised cleaned datasets with verified temporal integrity, along with comprehensive supporting documentation, including Doc21\_EDAReport, which provided EDA findings, domain knowledge validation summaries confirming energy system alignment, and detailed data-cleaning procedure documentation, and Doc22\_DataCleaningReport, which validated the final data quality.
